title: Inside the Prison
text: You are in prison for a crime you did not commit, scheduled to be executed today. Just before your time draws near, your court-appointed lawyer, Lucien Voss, enters the prison with some surprising information and a deal to offer you...
dmNotes:
# Who is in this scene

- **Lucien Voss** - the party's court appointed lawyers
- Guards - They get paid off by Lucien to leave so he can talk with the party

# What's happening

The party starts out in prison, and is set to be executed today. The opening scene they see their court-appointed lawyer, **Lucien Voss**, pay off the guards and walk over to their cells.

# What you need to do

As **Lucien Voss**, explain the following to the party:

    - Their former party member, **Gideon**, framed the party for murder (not true)
    - **Gideon** then went to the vault to take all the treasure for himself (not true)
    - **Lucien Voss** offers to free the party, in exchange for **Gideon**'s cut of the treasure
    - **Lucien** explains he cannot open the vault without the party, as there is a secret sequence only they know which opens the vault

Keep the following hidden from the party:

    - **Lucien Voss** is lying
    - **Lucien Voss** committed the murder, threw the case on purpose, and had kidnapped **Gideon**
    - **Lucien Voss** brought **Gideon** to the vault entrance, and when **Gideon** would not open it, **Lucien** murdered **Gideon**
    - Now with no way to open the vault, **Lucien Voss** attempts to ally himself with the party in an effort to get access to the treasure

# Possible Outcomes

## Expected path: The party agrees with Lucien's deal

In this case, Lucien will let the party free and distract the guards for them.

## Unexpected path: The party refuses Lucien's deal

The party may decide not to work with **Lucien Voss**, or they may decide to attack **Lucien Voss**.

The party may:

- steal the key from Lucien and escape the prison
- if Lucien leaves or escapes with the key and the party is still trapped, the guards will come back to carry out the execution, the party can attack at this point and escape
